holdout.method: three rolling-origin folds with non-overlapping test windows; weights frozen within each test window; prior results added only after all races on a date are scored; market-value bets use timestamped official pre-off odds snapshots

trifecta_diagnostics.interpretation: hit_rate is winning tickets divided by tickets; race_hit_rate is races with at least one winning ticket divided by races. ROI confidence intervals use a race-level normal ratio approximation and are diagnostic, not a promotion guarantee. Role coverage and ticket ROI are reported separately.

formation_2_4_5.allocation_method: Exploratory rank-weighted allocation with the same total stake per race as 100-yen equal staking. Historical pre-off trio combination odds are unavailable, so these policies are not expected-value or Kelly staking.

12.selection: lowest sum of the three LAB horse ranks among the original 19 unique 2-4-5 combinations
12.allocation: 19 equal 100-yen units distributed across the selected tickets

10.selection: lowest sum of the three LAB horse ranks among the original 19 unique 2-4-5 combinations
10.allocation: 19 equal 100-yen units distributed across the selected tickets

trio_diagnostics.interpretation: Trio tickets are unordered combinations. hit_rate is winning tickets divided by tickets; race_hit_rate is races with at least one winning ticket divided by races. ROI confidence intervals use a race-level normal ratio approximation and are diagnostic, not a promotion guarantee. Top5 is the unchanged fixed baseline. formation_2_4_5 is top2 / top4 / ranks3-7 with duplicate unordered combinations removed. The 12- and 10-ticket subsets are selected from those same 19 combinations by the lowest sum of LAB ranks; each keeps the same 1,900-yen race budget by distributing 19 equal 100-yen units. These are research comparisons, not live betting rules.

D_preoff_odds.policy: For each bet type, rank the full pre-off candidate universe by expected value, model hit probability, or market odds; buy the same fixed top-N count. Select a ranking only on the first 70% of dates and evaluate it on the untouched last 30%. A strategy is not validated unless its holdout has adequate sample and race-cluster bootstrap 95% ROI lower bound above 100%.

comparison_policy: A-C are evaluated on identical chronological holdout races with identical ticket construction and 100 JPY per ticket. B and C share the same learned base weights intentionally so their difference isolates the added feature blocks; A is the fixed baseline. D is evaluated only on races with valid genuine pre-off snapshots and is never imputed for missing snapshots.
